name: HIPAA Critical (Strong Signature + Clinical Document)
description: Engine 1. High-confidence PHI with a strong identity anchor; single record reportable. Three pathways: (1) Medical Document or Medical Imaging classifier + identifier; (2) Medical Information context with clinical density (Drugs > 4, Diseases > 2, Treatments > 4, or an NDC code) + identifier; (3) clinical-narrative structure (> 3 markers) with clinical content + identifier.
expression: ((((D:Medical Document > 0) OR (D:Medical Imaging > 0)) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Names (US) > 0))) OR ((D:Medical Information > 0) AND ((D:Drugs Information > 4) OR (D:Diseases Information > 2) OR (D:Treatments Information > 4) OR (D:NDC Number (Package) > 0) OR (D:NDC Number (Product) > 0)) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Names (US) > 0))) OR ((D:Custom-Clinical-Narrative > 3) AND ((D:Diseases Information > 0) OR (D:Drugs Information > 0) OR (D:Treatments Information > 0)) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Names (US) > 0))))

name: HIPAA Narrative / Low Volume
description: Engine 2. Short-form clinical content (referral letters, prior authorizations, prescription notes) that will not reach Engine 1's density: clinical terms > 2 with a name and a second identifier (SSN, DOB, MRN or member id).
expression: (((D:Diseases Information > 2) OR (D:Drugs Information > 2) OR (D:Treatments Information > 2)) AND (D:Names (US) > 0) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0)))

name: HIPAA Identity Trifecta
description: Engine 3. Identity-theft-grade combinations independent of clinical content, reportable under most state breach laws: strict trifecta (SSN + DOB + name) or the expanded branch (name + DOB + driver's licence, enhanced driver's licence or TIN). Without a DOB the expanded branch never fires.
expression: (((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) AND (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) AND (D:Names (US) > 0)) OR ((D:Names (US) > 0) AND (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) AND ((D:Driver's License (United States) > 0) OR (D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States) > 0) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) > 0))))

name: HIPAA Sensitive Subcategory
description: Engine 4. Mental health, substance use disorder (42 CFR Part 2), HIV, genetic (GINA) and reproductive PHI beside an identifier: elevated handling, restricted reviewer queue. Terms and gene names from the custom markers, ICD-10 codes from Diseases Information, informal language from Self-Harm & Cyberbullying and Illegal Drugs.
expression: (((D:Custom-Sensitive-Condition-Markers > 0) OR (D:Diseases Information > 0) OR (D:Self-Harm & Cyberbullying > 0) OR (D:Illegal Drugs > 0)) AND ((D:Names (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0)))

name: HIPAA Pharmacy / Claims / Billing
description: Engine 5. Pharmacy pathway: drug evidence (Drugs > 2 or an NDC code) + identifier + a provider or narrative anchor (NPI or clinical narrative). Claims pathway: billing density (> 2 billing phrases) or the Insurance Document classifier + clinical evidence + identifier (including a card number on a claim document; the clinical gate keeps pure payments out).
expression: ((((D:Drugs Information > 2) OR (D:NDC Number (Package) > 0) OR (D:NDC Number (Product) > 0)) AND ((D:Names (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0)) AND ((D:National Provider Identifier > 0) OR (D:Custom-Clinical-Narrative > 0))) OR (((D:Custom-Insurance-Billing > 2) OR (D:Insurance Document > 0)) AND ((D:Diseases Information > 0) OR (D:Treatments Information > 0)) AND ((D:Names (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0) OR (D:Credit Cards > 0))))

name: HIPAA Bulk PHI - Small
description: Engine 6, small tier (> 1 identifiers): any multi-record exposure of SSN, MRN, member id, NPI, TIN, driver's licence or enhanced driver's licence. The API has no Sum operator, so the tier is expressed per dictionary; a transaction with 2 or more of one identifier kind matches.
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 1) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 1) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 1) OR (D:National Provider Identifier > 1) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) > 1) OR (D:Driver's License (United States) > 1) OR (D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States) > 1))

name: HIPAA Bulk PHI - Significant
description: Engine 6, significant tier (> 50 identifiers of one kind): executive escalation, still under the 500-individual notification threshold.
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 50) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 50) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 50) OR (D:National Provider Identifier > 50) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) > 50) OR (D:Driver's License (United States) > 50) OR (D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States) > 50))

name: HIPAA Bulk PHI - Major
description: Engine 6, MAJOR tier (> 500 identifiers of one kind): a potential 500+ individual breach; routes straight to the Privacy Officer, legal counsel and executive incident response.
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 500) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 500) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 500) OR (D:National Provider Identifier > 500) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) > 500) OR (D:Driver's License (United States) > 500) OR (D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States) > 500))
